'''Variable holdout blasters''' were short-ranged [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|holdout blasters]] that were popular with [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] operatives on [[Ord Gimmel/Legends|Ord Gimmel]]. The [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] could vary the strength of its shots, but this came at the cost of a smaller [[Power cell/Legends|power pack]]. Each blaster cost 400 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
